fields.statement: At d23439f6, built rhiza (go build -trimpath) into a scratch dir and, in a fresh git repo under a scratch Rhiza root with its own XDG_CONFIG_HOME: rhiza init; rhiza workflow new bugfix; workflow check bugfix (valid); ran the doc's two bash blocks extracted from docs/custom-workflows.md, which wrote .rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml and .rhiza/dispatch.toml; rhiza workflow check bugfix printed 'workflow bugfix is valid' exit 0; workflow describe bugfix showed reproduce->fix->test (on.fail -> fix)->ci->done/failed; workflow new mine --from ship-change then check passed; workflow ls listed bugfix and mine as repo; with a current change set, rhiza run start --workflow bugfix --dry-run printed 'Run ... would start' at step reproduce, writing nothing. The reference is named as plain path docs/reference/workflow-file.md per decision custom-workflow-doc-reference-plain-path. go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/custom-workflows-doc and ./internal/doclinks pass.

At d23439f6, with the built binary: every rhiza command named in docs/agents.md exists (each answers --help); rhiza guide ls lists the topics and rhiza guide build prints; rhiza guide install --help shows --agent claude, --project (repo .claude/skills/) and --force exactly as the doc says; slice, ready, apply, land, render exist; its links (quickstart, concepts/change-sets.md, concepts/why.md) resolve (internal/doclinks TestRepoDocsLinksResolve passes). Trailer rules match rhiza guide build.

At d23439f6, with the built binary in a scratch repo: every rhiza command in docs/runs-and-daemon.md exists (--help); guide install, rex install --force, run send-back --note, request --kind/--ref match; daemon settings lists every named setting; daemon set rhiza.autonomy.{plan,accept,ship,signoff} owner works; the doc's [[schedules]] weekly-deps block in dispatch.toml is accepted (rhiza health: '1 schedule ... next run 2026-11-09T09:00:00Z'). But: daemon settings shows defaults autonomy.accept/ship/signoff = auto, contradicting the doc's 'By default the daemon asks you at every gate'; rhiza request and run start fail 'is not inside a Rhiza root / next: rhiza root init' until rhiza root init + project add, which the doc's setup never mentions; and workflow-file autonomy (autonomous = true|false or [autonomy] table, internal/workflow/workflow.go parseAutonomy) is not described, though the leaf names per-workflow autonomy.
